description: This file is a header file for the PduR_CanTp module in an AUTOSAR-based automotive software stack. It declares functions related to the CAN Transport Protocol (CanTp) interface within the PDU Router component, including buffer provision, indication, and confirmation functions.

methods.name: PduR_CanTpProvideRxBuffer
methods.description: Provides a receive buffer for the CanTp module, given a PDU ID, length, and pointer to PDU info.

methods.name: PduR_CanTpRxIndication
methods.description: Indicates reception completion for a specific PDU with a result status.

methods.name: PduR_CanTpProvideTxBuffer
methods.description: Provides a transmit buffer for the CanTp module, given a PDU ID, length, and pointer to PDU info.

methods.name: PduR_CanTpTxConfirmation
methods.description: Confirms the transmission of a PDU with a result status.
